_readme: Config for scripts/build_episodes.py and scripts/build_thumbnails.py. Copy to the project root, fill in, and pass with --config. Relative paths resolve against this file. Text sizes in `design` are canvas pixels tuned for 4K; set text_scale 0.5 for 1080p. `format` is "series" (numbered episodes) or "film" (one long film: exactly one entry in `episodes`, no episode numbers on the title card, thumbnail or file name; for a film set text.thumb_eyebrow to the series line or delete it).

subtitles._readme: Per-series rules for scripts/build_subtitles.py. speech_script: the script the speech is written in (thai, kana, cjk, hangul, cyrillic, arabic, devanagari), or "" when the speech is in Latin script. drop_scripts: scripts that never occur in this footage, so a cue containing one is an ASR hallucination (a Thai series abroad: ["cyrillic", "latin-ext"]). keep_words: Latin words that are real when glued onto the speech script; place-stamp words are added automatically. fixes: {"wrong regex": "right"} for known ASR errors.
